info.desc: It was a highly anticipated follow-up to both their United States debut album, and their second internationally released CD. It was their first record to be released in both the U.S. and internationally in the same form, at the same time. In the United States, it holds the record for most shipments in one year, with 11 million in 1999. It was nominated for five Grammy Awards and spawned four Top 40 singles, including the single "I Want It That Way." Three of the singles, "I Want It That Way", "Larger Than Life" and "Show Me The Meaning Of Being .

podcast.body: Released in June 1999, this album broke an all-time sales record by selling 1.13 million copies in its first week alone. "And then in June, the Backstreet Boys' Millennium album broke an all-time sales record, moving 1.13 million copies just in its first week."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 00's Part 1: The Sad State of Rock

podcast.body: Released on May 18, 1999, this CD sold over 500,000 copies on its first day and achieved 1.134 million sales by the end of its first week in the US, setting a new all-time sales record at the time. Worldwide totals were much higher than just the US numbers. "On that first day it sold more than 500,000 copies. By the end of the week it sold 1.134 million, a new all-time sales record."
